senses.en: a written or spoken description of what happened
senses.pattern: an eyewitness account / give an account of / by all accounts
senses.example: The two witnesses gave very different [[accounts]] of how the accident on the bridge had happened.
senses.example_zh: 對於橋上那場事故的發生經過，兩名目擊者的說法大不相同。

senses.en: (account for) to form a particular part of a total
senses.pattern: account for 30% of / account for half of / account for a large share of
senses.example: Tourism [[accounts]] for nearly a third of the island's income, so every typhoon season worries local businesses.
senses.example_zh: 觀光業占該島收入將近三分之一，因此每到颱風季當地商家都很擔心。

senses.en: (account for) to give or be the reason for something
senses.pattern: account for the difference / account for the delay / hard to account for
senses.example: Researchers could not [[account]] for the sudden drop in the number of bees in the valley.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員無法解釋山谷裡蜜蜂數量為何突然減少。

gsat.sentence: Another [[account]] claims that David Jung, a Chinese immigrant living in Los Angeles, created the fortune cookie in 1918.
Today, tea can be drunk at any time of the day, and [[accounts]] for over two-fifths of all beverages consumed in Britain—with the exception of water.

senses.en: only; without including anything else
senses.pattern: last year alone / in this city alone / price alone / this fact alone
senses.example: Last month [[alone]], the animal shelter took in over two hundred abandoned cats and dogs.
senses.example_zh: 單單上個月，這間動物收容所就收容了兩百多隻遭棄養的貓狗。
senses.note: 置於所修飾的名詞之後

gsat.sentence: In the year 1990 [[alone]], the growth in trade in services was as high as 19%.
It is reported that hip-hop fashion [[alone]] generates $750 million to $1 billion annually.

senses.en: to believe that something is important or valuable
senses.pattern: attach importance to / attach great value to / attach significance to
senses.example: Many parents [[attach]] great importance to grades, yet children also need time to play and rest.
senses.example_zh: 許多父母非常重視成績，但孩子也需要時間玩耍和休息。
senses.note: attach A to B，A 為 importance 等名詞

senses.en: (be attached to) to like someone or something very much
senses.pattern: be attached to sb / grow attached to / be deeply attached to
senses.example: After three years in the mountain village, the young teacher had grown deeply [[attached]] to the place and its people.
senses.example_zh: 在山村待了三年後，這位年輕老師已深深依戀這個地方和當地的人。
senses.note: 常用被動 be attached to

senses.en: (become of) to happen to someone or something
senses.pattern: what became of / what will become of / whatever became of
senses.example: Nobody in the neighborhood knows what [[became]] of the old bookstore owner after he moved away.
senses.example_zh: 這一帶沒有人知道那位舊書店老闆搬走之後的遭遇如何。
senses.note: 只用於 what／whatever 開頭的句型

senses.en: to look good on or be suitable for someone
senses.pattern: that color becomes you / blue becomes her / it ill becomes sb to do
senses.example: That dark green jacket really [[becomes]] you; you should wear it to the graduation ceremony.
senses.example_zh: 那件深綠色外套真的很適合你，你應該穿去參加畢業典禮。

gsat.sentence: This situation is so strange to us that we do not know what will [[become]] of it.

senses.en: having a natural ability to do something well
senses.pattern: a born leader / a born teacher / a born storyteller
senses.example: Calm under pressure and trusted by everyone, Mia is a [[born]] leader on the debate team.
senses.example_zh: 米亞在壓力下沉著冷靜，又受大家信任，是辯論隊裡天生的領袖。

senses.en: (born of) existing as a result of something
senses.pattern: born of necessity / born of experience / born out of frustration
senses.example: Her decision to study medicine was [[born]] of the months she spent caring for her sick grandfather.
senses.example_zh: 她決定讀醫，是源自那幾個月照顧生病祖父的經歷。

gsat.sentence: To argue against the assumption that Russians are [[born]] drinkers.

senses.en: to express or record a feeling or scene accurately
senses.pattern: capture the spirit of / capture the mood / capture the moment / capture sth on camera
senses.example: The short film perfectly [[captures]] the excitement and nervousness of the first day at a new school.
senses.example_zh: 這部短片完美捕捉了到新學校第一天那種興奮又緊張的心情。

senses.en: to attract and hold someone's interest or attention
senses.pattern: capture the imagination of / capture sb's attention / capture the interest of
senses.example: The story of a dog that waited years for its owner [[captured]] the imagination of readers worldwide.
senses.example_zh: 一隻狗苦等主人多年的故事，深深吸引了全世界的讀者。

senses.en: to succeed in getting a share of something
senses.pattern: capture a share of the market / capture 40% of the vote / capture the title
senses.example: Within two years, the small startup had [[captured]] nearly half of the local market for electric scooters.
senses.example_zh: 短短兩年內，這家小型新創公司就奪得了當地電動機車市場將近一半的市占率。

gsat.sentence: Which of the following sayings best [[captures]] the spirit of Jeanie Low’s story?
Although about 90 percent of American households still use film cameras, digital cameras are [[capturing]] a growing share of the consumer market.

senses.en: to stop something from increasing or getting worse
senses.pattern: check the spread of / check the growth of / check inflation / keep sth in check
senses.example: Health officials closed several schools to [[check]] the spread of the flu during the winter.
senses.example_zh: 衛生官員關閉了數所學校，以抑制流感在冬季蔓延。

senses.en: a bill for a meal in a restaurant
senses.pattern: ask for the check / pay the check / split the check
senses.example: When the meal was over, Uncle Ben asked the waiter for the [[check]] and paid for everyone.
senses.example_zh: 用餐結束後，班叔叔向服務生要了帳單，替大家付了錢。

senses.en: a pattern of squares in two or more colors
senses.pattern: a check shirt / a blue and white check / a checked tablecloth
senses.example: The school uniform is a white shirt and a skirt in a green and blue [[check]].
senses.example_zh: 這所學校的制服是白襯衫配上藍綠格紋的裙子。

gsat.sentence: Red is a popular color, and women generally opt for [[checked]], striped, or patterned pieces of cloth.

senses.en: a tall stone post, or something with that shape
senses.pattern: marble columns / stone columns / a column of smoke
senses.example: Thick white [[columns]] hold up the roof of the old temple at the top of the hill.
senses.example_zh: 粗大的白色圓柱支撐著山頂那座古老神殿的屋頂。

senses.en: a vertical section of a table or page
senses.pattern: the left-hand column / a column of figures / rows and columns
senses.example: Write each student's name in the first [[column]] of the table and the score in the second.
senses.example_zh: 把每位學生的名字寫在表格的第一個直欄，分數寫在第二欄。

gsat.sentence: The oldest spiral staircase still standing today is at Trajan’s [[Column]] in Rome.
The trunk of redwood trees is very stout and usually forms a single straight [[column]].

senses.en: importance or significance
senses.pattern: of no consequence / of little consequence / a matter of great consequence
senses.example: The color of the cover is of little [[consequence]]; what matters is whether the book is useful.
senses.example_zh: 封面的顏色沒什麼重要性；要緊的是這本書實不實用。
senses.note: 此義不可數，常用 of little/no ~

senses.en: to frighten someone into doing what you want
senses.pattern: be cowed by / be cowed into silence / refuse to be cowed
senses.example: The villagers refused to be [[cowed]] by the threats and kept protesting against the polluting factory.
senses.example_zh: 面對種種威脅，村民不受威嚇，持續抗議那家製造污染的工廠。

senses.en: to refuse to give or allow someone something
senses.pattern: deny sb access to / be denied entry / deny sb the right to / deny a request
senses.example: The hospital was accused of [[denying]] poor patients the treatment they urgently needed.
senses.example_zh: 這家醫院被指控拒絕給予貧困病患迫切需要的治療。
senses.note: deny + 人 + 物；被動 be denied sth

senses.en: (deny yourself) to not let yourself have something
senses.pattern: deny oneself sth / deny oneself nothing / deny oneself the pleasure of
senses.example: To save money for college, he [[denied]] himself even small pleasures like snacks and movies.
senses.example_zh: 為了存大學學費，他克制自己，連零食、電影這類小小的享受都不碰。

senses.en: (of a change) sudden, very great, and noticeable
senses.pattern: a dramatic increase / a dramatic change / a dramatic drop / a dramatic improvement
senses.example: The past decade has seen a [[dramatic]] increase in the number of people working from home.
senses.example_zh: 過去十年間，在家工作的人數急遽增加。

senses.zh: 驚險刺激的；引人注目的
senses.en: exciting and impressive
senses.pattern: a dramatic rescue / a dramatic finish / dramatic scenery
senses.example: Firefighters carried out a [[dramatic]] rescue, pulling the driver out seconds before the car caught fire.
senses.example_zh: 消防員上演了一場驚險刺激的救援，在車子起火前幾秒把駕駛拉了出來。

gsat.sentence: For some people, even a five-minute nap can bring about surprisingly [[dramatic]] benefits.
But the growth of public television in the past two decades has been [[dramatic]].

senses.en: an aim or purpose
senses.pattern: a means to an end / to this end / an end in itself / achieve one's own ends
senses.example: For her, money is only a means to an [[end]]; what she really wants is freedom to travel.
senses.example_zh: 對她來說，金錢只是達成目的的手段；她真正想要的是旅行的自由。

senses.en: the front or surface of something
senses.pattern: a clock face / the north face of a mountain / a rock face / the face of the earth
senses.example: The climbers spent two days on the steep north [[face]] of the mountain before reaching the top.
senses.example_zh: 登山隊在這座山陡峭的北面花了兩天才登頂。

senses.en: to be turned or pointed toward a direction
senses.pattern: face south / face the sea / face each other / a room facing the street
senses.example: Our classroom [[faces]] east, so the morning sun shines directly on the blackboard.
senses.example_zh: 我們的教室朝向東方，所以早晨的陽光會直接照在黑板上。

senses.en: to take a job, or choose someone for it
senses.pattern: fill a position / fill a vacancy / fill the role of
senses.example: The school is still looking for someone to [[fill]] the position of head basketball coach.
senses.example_zh: 學校仍在找人填補籃球隊總教練的職缺。

senses.en: to provide something that is needed or missing
senses.pattern: fill a need / fill a gap in the market / fill an order
senses.example: The new night bus [[fills]] a real need for workers who finish their shifts after midnight.
senses.example_zh: 新的夜間公車滿足了午夜後才下班的勞工的實際需求。

senses.en: to make an innocent person seem guilty
senses.pattern: be framed for / frame sb for a crime / claim to have been framed
senses.example: The detective discovered that the young clerk had been [[framed]] by the real thief.
senses.example_zh: 偵探發現那名年輕店員是被真正的小偷陷害的。

senses.en: to express something carefully in particular words
senses.pattern: frame a question / frame a reply / frame the issue as
senses.example: She [[framed]] her question carefully so that it would not embarrass the guest speaker.
senses.example_zh: 她小心斟酌提問的措辭，以免讓演講來賓難堪。

senses.en: very serious and worrying; solemn
senses.pattern: grave concerns / grave danger / a grave mistake / a grave expression
senses.example: The long drought has put the region's rice farmers in [[grave]] danger of losing their entire harvest.
senses.example_zh: 長期乾旱使該地區的稻農面臨失去全部收成的嚴重危險。
senses.note: 副詞 gravely；名詞 gravity 嚴重性

gsat.sentence: Deadly shootings on US campuses have raised [[grave]] concerns about how to prevent such tragic incidents from happening again.

senses.en: to provide a place for people or things
senses.pattern: house refugees / house a collection / be housed in
senses.example: The gym was turned into a shelter to [[house]] families who had lost their homes in the flood.
senses.example_zh: 體育館被改成避難所，收容在水災中失去家園的家庭。

senses.en: a company in a particular business, such as publishing
senses.pattern: a publishing house / a fashion house / an auction house
senses.example: Her first novel was turned down by five publishing [[houses]] before it finally became a bestseller.
senses.example_zh: 她的第一本小說被五家出版公司退稿，最後才成為暢銷書。

gsat.sentence: The booth he built [[housed]] only an old dial phone with a disconnected phone line.

senses.en: to increase suddenly by a large amount
senses.pattern: jump by 20% / jump from A to B / prices jump / sales jump
senses.example: Vegetable prices [[jumped]] by forty percent after the typhoon destroyed crops across the south.
senses.example_zh: 颱風摧毀南部各地的農作物後，菜價暴漲了四成。
senses.note: 亦作名詞：a jump in prices 價格驟升

senses.en: to move suddenly because of surprise or fear
senses.pattern: make sb jump / jump at the noise / jump out of one's skin
senses.example: A loud knock on the window made everyone in the quiet library [[jump]].
senses.example_zh: 窗戶上一聲響亮的敲擊，讓安靜的圖書館裡每個人都嚇一跳。

senses.en: the exact words of a rule, not its spirit
senses.pattern: the letter of the law / to the letter / follow instructions to the letter
senses.example: The company obeyed the [[letter]] of the law but ignored its real purpose of protecting workers.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司遵守了法律條文的字面意義，卻忽視了保護勞工的真正用意。
senses.note: to the letter＝不折不扣地、嚴格地

senses.en: a small glass ball used in children's games
senses.pattern: play marbles / a bag of marbles / a glass marble
senses.example: The children knelt on the ground, taking turns shooting glass [[marbles]] into a small hole.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們跪在地上，輪流把玻璃彈珠彈進一個小洞裡。
senses.note: 此義可數；play marbles 打彈珠

senses.en: a group of people sent abroad for official work
senses.pattern: a trade mission / a diplomatic mission / a medical mission
senses.example: A trade [[mission]] of thirty business leaders visited Vietnam to look for new partners.
senses.example_zh: 一個由三十位企業領袖組成的貿易代表團訪問越南，尋找新的合作夥伴。

senses.en: a religious group or place doing work to spread a faith
senses.pattern: a mission school / a mission hospital / a Christian mission
senses.example: The doctor spent ten years at a Christian [[mission]] in the mountains, treating villagers for free.
senses.example_zh: 這位醫師在山區一處基督教傳教機構待了十年，免費替村民看病。

senses.en: a person who is not important or famous
senses.pattern: a nobody / a complete nobody / treat sb like a nobody
senses.example: Two years ago she was a [[nobody]], but today millions of fans follow her online.
senses.example_zh: 兩年前她還是個無名小卒，如今卻有數百萬粉絲在網路上追蹤她。
senses.note: 可數，複數 nobodies；反義 somebody

senses.en: a large keyboard instrument with pipes
senses.pattern: play the organ / a church organ / organ music
senses.example: Every Sunday morning, the sound of the [[organ]] fills the small stone church by the river.
senses.example_zh: 每個星期天早上，管風琴的樂聲迴盪在河邊那座小石造教堂裡。

senses.en: an official organization that is part of a larger body
senses.pattern: an organ of government / state organs / the official organ of
senses.example: Courts are important [[organs]] of the state, and they must stay independent to protect citizens' rights.
senses.example_zh: 法院是國家的重要機關，必須保持獨立才能保障人民的權利。

senses.en: a long narrow way that connects two places
senses.pattern: a narrow passage / an underground passage / a secret passage
senses.example: A narrow underground [[passage]] connects the castle kitchen with the river outside the walls.
senses.example_zh: 一條狹窄的地下通道把城堡的廚房和城牆外的河流連接起來。

senses.en: the process of time passing
senses.pattern: the passage of time / with the passage of time / the passage of years
senses.example: Wrinkles and gray hair are natural signs of the [[passage]] of time, not something to be ashamed of.
senses.example_zh: 皺紋和白髮是時間流逝的自然痕跡，並不是什麼丟臉的事。

senses.en: the process of a law being officially approved
senses.pattern: the passage of a bill / the passage of the law / secure passage of
senses.example: The [[passage]] of the new law means that restaurants can no longer give out plastic straws.
senses.example_zh: 新法通過，意味著餐廳不能再提供塑膠吸管。

senses.en: a company or person that is important in a field
senses.pattern: a major player / a key player in / a global player
senses.example: A family-run firm from Denmark has become a key [[player]] in the global wind-power industry.
senses.example_zh: 一家來自丹麥的家族企業已成為全球風力發電產業的要角。

senses.en: newspapers, magazines, and the people who work for them
senses.pattern: the press / freedom of the press / a press conference / press coverage
senses.example: The singer refused to talk to the [[press]] about her private life after the concert.
senses.example_zh: 演唱會結束後，這位歌手拒絕向媒體談論她的私生活。

senses.en: to try hard to make someone do or say something
senses.pattern: press sb for an answer / press sb to do sth / press sb on the issue
senses.example: Reporters [[pressed]] the coach for a clear answer about the injured player, but he refused to comment.
senses.example_zh: 記者一再逼問教練受傷球員的狀況，要他給個明確答覆，但他拒絕評論。

senses.en: a machine for printing; a business that publishes books
senses.pattern: a printing press / a university press / go to press
senses.example: The invention of the printing [[press]] made books cheap enough for ordinary families to buy.
senses.example_zh: 印刷機的發明使書籍便宜到一般家庭都買得起。

gsat.sentence: In 1476 he returned to England and established a printing [[press]] at Westminster.

senses.en: a force that attracts or draws something
senses.pattern: the pull of gravity / the pull of the moon / feel the pull of the city
senses.example: The moon's [[pull]] on the oceans causes the tides to rise and fall twice a day.
senses.example_zh: 月球對海洋的引力使潮汐每天漲落兩次。

senses.en: to injure a muscle by stretching it too much
senses.pattern: pull a muscle / pull a hamstring / a pulled muscle
senses.example: He [[pulled]] a muscle in his leg during the race and had to stop running.
senses.example_zh: 他在比賽中拉傷了腿部肌肉，不得不停下來。

gsat.sentence: In the earlier days of space travel, scientists tried to overcome the force of gravity so that a rocket could shoot free of Earth’s [[pull]] in order to land humans on the moon.

senses.en: to force someone or something into a worse state
senses.pattern: be reduced to tears / be reduced to begging / reduce sth to ashes / be reduced to rubble
senses.example: After losing his job, the proud engineer was [[reduced]] to borrowing money from old friends.
senses.example_zh: 失業之後，這位自尊心很強的工程師淪落到得向老朋友借錢度日。
senses.note: 常用被動 be reduced to + N/V-ing

senses.en: a machine at an amusement park that people ride on
senses.pattern: amusement park rides / go on a ride / a thrilling ride
senses.example: The roller coaster is the most popular [[ride]] in the park, and the line is always long.
senses.example_zh: 雲霄飛車是園內最受歡迎的遊樂設施，排隊的隊伍總是很長。

senses.en: an experience of a particular kind, easy or difficult
senses.pattern: a bumpy ride / a rough ride / an easy ride / a smooth ride
senses.example: New students often have a bumpy [[ride]] in their first semester before they learn to manage their time.
senses.example_zh: 新生在第一學期往往會經歷一段顛簸的歷程，之後才學會管理時間。

gsat.sentence: You may experience the discomfort from the motion of cars, boats, or amusement park [[rides]].
The [[rides]] are custom-designed to accommodate wheelchair riders so that every family member can enjoy the fun.

senses.en: an important news story reported before anyone else
senses.pattern: get a scoop / a big scoop / a major scoop
senses.example: The young reporter got the biggest [[scoop]] of her career when she was the first to interview the rescued climber.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕記者搶先訪問到那名獲救的登山客，拿到她職業生涯中最大的獨家新聞。

senses.en: something that makes you feel sad or disappointed
senses.pattern: it's a shame (that) / what a shame / it would be a shame to
senses.example: It is a [[shame]] that such a beautiful old theater will be torn down next month.
senses.example_zh: 這麼美麗的老戲院下個月就要拆除，真是件可惜的事。

senses.en: to make someone feel ashamed; to bring disgrace on
senses.pattern: shame sb into doing / shame one's family / be shamed by
senses.example: His classmates' hard work [[shamed]] him into finally starting his own part of the project.
senses.example_zh: 同學們的努力使他羞愧，終於開始做自己負責的那部分專題。
senses.note: 名詞片語 put … to shame＝使…相形見絀

senses.en: to have enough beds for a number of people
senses.pattern: sleep four / sleep up to six people / the tent sleeps two
senses.example: The mountain cabin [[sleeps]] eight, so it is perfect for our two families this summer.
senses.example_zh: 這間山中小木屋可供八人住宿，很適合我們兩家人今年夏天去住。

senses.en: a dish offered only that day, or a product on sale
senses.pattern: today's special / the lunch special / a weekly special
senses.example: Today's [[special]] is grilled fish with rice and soup, and it costs only ninety dollars.
senses.example_zh: 今日特餐是烤魚配飯和湯，只要九十元。

senses.en: a TV or radio program made for a particular occasion
senses.pattern: a TV special / a New Year special / a two-hour special
senses.example: The channel will air a two-hour [[special]] on sea turtles this Saturday night.
senses.example_zh: 該頻道本週六晚上將播出兩小時的海龜特別節目。

senses.en: not moving; calm and quiet
senses.pattern: stand still / sit still / keep still / still water
senses.example: The photographer asked the children to stand [[still]] for a few seconds while he took the picture.
senses.example_zh: 攝影師請孩子們站著靜止不動幾秒鐘，好讓他拍照。

senses.en: despite what has just been said
senses.pattern: Still, + clause / but still / and still
senses.example: The hike was long and tiring. [[Still]], everyone agreed that the view from the top was worth it.
senses.example_zh: 這趟健行又長又累。儘管如此，大家都認為山頂的景色很值得。
senses.note: 常置於句首，後面加逗號

gsat.sentence: [[Still]], many animal rights activists believe the cost of confining animals outweighs the benefits.
To make sure that your pet sits [[still]].

senses.en: to become worse in quality or condition
senses.pattern: grades suffer / quality suffers / sb's health suffers / business suffers
senses.example: If you stay up late playing games every night, your schoolwork will certainly [[suffer]].
senses.example_zh: 如果你每天晚上都熬夜打電動，課業表現一定會變差。

senses.en: to need a lot of effort; to put a strain on
senses.pattern: tax sb's patience / tax one's strength / tax resources
senses.example: Looking after three young children all day really [[taxes]] her patience.
senses.example_zh: 整天照顧三個年幼的孩子，實在很考驗她的耐心。

senses.en: strict and firm in dealing with something
senses.pattern: tough laws / get tough on / a tough stance / tougher regulations
senses.example: The city has introduced [[tough]] new rules to stop people from feeding pigeons in public squares.
senses.example_zh: 該市實施了嚴厲的新規定，禁止民眾在公共廣場餵鴿子。

senses.en: hard to cut, chew, or break
senses.pattern: tough meat / a tough steak / tough material / tough skin
senses.example: The steak was so [[tough]] that I could hardly cut it, let alone chew it.
senses.example_zh: 這塊牛排太老了，我幾乎切不動，更別說嚼了。

senses.en: strong enough to deal with difficult conditions
senses.pattern: mentally tough / a tough kid / tough enough to
senses.example: Growing up on a fishing boat made her [[tough]] enough to handle any hardship at sea.
senses.example_zh: 在漁船上長大，使她堅強得足以應付海上的任何艱苦。

gsat.sentence: The recent cooking oil scandals have led to calls for [[tougher]] regulation of sales of food products.
In a controlled environment, these films may actually reduce the negative impact on viewers and help them become [[tougher]].

senses.en: to increase a price, amount, or level
senses.pattern: up the price / up the pace / up one's game
senses.example: The airline [[upped]] its ticket prices twice last year because of rising fuel costs.
senses.example_zh: 由於燃料成本上漲，這家航空公司去年兩度提高票價。

senses.en: (of a period of time) finished
senses.pattern: time is up / when the two weeks are up / before the hour is up
senses.example: When the thirty minutes were [[up]], the teacher told everyone to put down their pens.
senses.example_zh: 三十分鐘時間一到，老師就要大家把筆放下。
senses.note: 只放在 be 動詞後

senses.en: pleasant and wanted, because it comes when needed
senses.pattern: a welcome change / a welcome relief / welcome news / a welcome break
senses.example: After weeks of burning heat, the afternoon rain brought a [[welcome]] relief to the whole city.
senses.example_zh: 連續幾週酷熱之後，午後這場雨為全市帶來可喜的涼意。

senses.en: to be pleased to accept an idea or change
senses.pattern: welcome the decision / welcome the change / welcome suggestions
senses.example: Most teachers [[welcomed]] the plan to reduce class sizes, saying it would help weaker students.
senses.example_zh: 多數教師樂於接受縮小班級人數的計畫，認為這對程度較弱的學生有幫助。

gsat.sentence: A casual clothes code is [[welcomed]] by young employees.

quiz.stem: After the earthquake damaged their dormitory, the 120 students were temporarily ______ in a nearby hotel until the repairs were finished.
quiz.explain_zh: house＝收容、安置。宿舍受損後，學生暫時被安置在附近的旅館。

quiz.stem: Scientists warn that plastic waste in the oceans poses a ______ threat to sea animals, many of which die after swallowing it.
quiz.explain_zh: grave＝嚴重的。海洋中的塑膠垃圾對海洋動物構成嚴重的威脅。

quiz.stem: The city hopes to cut traffic accidents by half, and to that ______, it has lowered the speed limit near every school.
quiz.explain_zh: end＝目的。為了達到車禍減半的目的，市府調降學校附近的速限。

quiz.stem: Carrying heavy equipment up the mountain for ten hours would ______ the strength of even the most experienced hiker.
quiz.explain_zh: tax＝使負重擔、考驗。扛重裝備爬山十小時，對老手的體力也是考驗。

quiz.stem: With its low prices and fast delivery, the online bookstore has quickly become a major ______ in the country's book market.
quiz.explain_zh: player＝要角。這家網路書店已成為該國圖書市場的要角。

quiz.stem: Online orders ______ for more than half of the restaurant's sales last year, so the owner decided to hire two more delivery workers.
quiz.explain_zh: account＝占（比例）。網路訂單占餐廳去年營業額的一半以上。

quiz.stem: The typhoon caused heavy losses across the region; in one southern county ______, over two thousand hectares of banana farms were destroyed.
quiz.explain_zh: alone＝僅僅、單單。單單南部一個縣就有兩千多公頃蕉園被毀。

quiz.stem: Critics say the judge was not ______ enough on drunk drivers, most of whom only had to pay a small fine.
quiz.explain_zh: tough＝嚴厲的。批評者認為法官對酒駕者不夠嚴厲，多數人只需繳少量罰款。

quiz.stem: Several visitors were ______ entry to the laboratory because they had not completed the required safety training.
quiz.explain_zh: deny＝拒絕給予、不准。訪客未完成安全訓練，因此不准進入實驗室。

quiz.stem: With the ______ of time, the wall paintings in the old temple have gradually lost their bright colors and now need careful repair.
quiz.explain_zh: passage＝（時間）流逝。隨著時間流逝，古廟壁畫逐漸失去鮮豔的色彩。
